## For a future reader (or `/failure-autopsy`) on THIS run

If `spawn_match_rate` is below 0.8, the shared-candidate-order fix
still left too many boundaries with genuinely divergent hazard/resource occupancy between
arms (hazard drift can differ enough by segment>1 to exclude the shared first choice in
one arm but not the other) -- a successor could canonicalize the occupied-set reference
(e.g. always filter against the ep0 canonical hazard/resource set rather than each arm's
live drifted set) to raise the match rate further. If `n_sleep_firing_matched_comparisons`
is small despite 6 seeds, the K=10 cadence did not fire enough within 24 segments for some
seeds -- lower `sleep_loop_episodes_K` or raise `EVAL_EPISODES` in a successor. This run
does NOT attempt the transfer test or blinded umpire (Section 13d items 4-5) -- those are
gated on THIS run producing `coherence_lift_significant=True`.

interpretation.label: mech490_precondition_unmet
interpretation.combination_rule: evidence_direction = 'non_contributory' if non_degenerate is False, else 'supports' if (mean_run_length sign-test p<0.05 across >=5 seeds) AND (commit_gate_engagement_rate_delta Pearson r >= +0.3 with mean_run_length_delta), else 'weakens' if the coherence lift is significant but does NOT covary with commit-gate engagement, else 'non_contributory' (lift itself not significant -- underpowered/null, informative neither way).
interpretation.note: outcome PASS/FAIL is a MECHANICAL run-health verdict (core channels vary, harm-pathway trained, layout continuity + sleep ablation engaged) and is INDEPENDENT of evidence_direction, which is the scientific MECH-490 verdict. 14 matched WITH_SLEEP-vs-NO_SLEEP comparisons across 6 seeds; spawn_match_rate=0.786; claim_ids=['MECH-490']; evidence_direction=non_contributory.

sleep_driver_pattern: K=10 multi-fire (SleepLoopManager) vs K=never, two-arm ablation
